title: Chapter 1: Introduction to AI Agents and Digital FTEs

questions.question: What does FTE stand for in the context of AI Digital Workers?
questions.explanation: FTE stands for Full-Time Equivalent — a standard HR unit representing one human working ~40 hours/week. A Digital FTE is an AI agent designed to match or exceed that output at 168 hours/week.

questions.question: Which THREE components combine to create a Digital FTE?
questions.explanation: A Digital FTE combines: (1) Large Language Models for reasoning, (2) Tool Use to call APIs and databases, and (3) Agentic Loops that allow the agent to plan, act, observe, and adapt across multiple steps.

questions.question: In the Agent Factory Architecture, which layer handles the HTTP interface?
questions.explanation: Layer 3 (FastAPI) is the HTTP interface layer in the 8-layer Agent Factory Architecture. It handles incoming requests and routes them to the appropriate backend logic.

questions.question: What is the key architectural decision in Phase 1 (Zero-Backend-LLM)?

options.A: The backend calls Claude for every request
options.B: All reasoning happens in the ChatGPT App; the backend is fully deterministic
options.C: The database handles AI inference using pg_vector
options.D: Cloudflare R2 runs a serverless LLM for content generation

questions.explanation: In Zero-Backend-LLM architecture, the FastAPI backend is 100% deterministic — no LLM calls. All intelligent reasoning is handled by the ChatGPT App (the frontend LLM). This eliminates per-request LLM costs on the server.

questions.question: How many hours per week does a Digital FTE work compared to a human FTE?

options.D: 168 hours — every hour of every day

questions.explanation: A Digital FTE works 168 hours per week — every hour of every day (24 x 7 = 168). This continuous availability, combined with ~99% consistency and dramatically lower cost, is the core value proposition.
